fact: At the national workshop of 13 August 2026 the ministry said PLANETE 3, unlike earlier versions limited to middle and secondary, now includes primary, and that enrolments and re-enrolments go through it from the 2026-2027 school year; 6,898 schools are connected.
title: À Saly, le ministère de l’Éducation veut faire passer le numérique éducatif “de la promesse à la preuve”
